attempts.summary: Configured dnsmasq on node1 to resolve inventory-api.internal -> node2 (10.100.0.11) and forward all other queries upstream; configured node2's resolv.conf (via NetworkManager) to use node1 (10.100.0.10) as its sole DNS resolver. Fixed a boot-race issue found during restart testing (dnsmasq bind-interfaces failed before IP was assigned) by switching to bind-dynamic and adding a network-online.target dependency. Both nodes were restarted one at a time with verified changed boot IDs and confirmed post-restart recovery of DNS service and resolution.
